page_title: BOL 0-2 LAZ | Bologna v Lazio 22/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Ermano Feliciani is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' Good work from Bologna as they win a corner.

90+4' A cross from Juan Miranda (Bologna) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. The ball goes behind for a corner. Bologna will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

90+3' Martin Vitik (Bologna) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the bottom left corner. Edoardo Motta has a clear sight of it makes a comfortable save.
90+1' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) is penalised for a foul. Ermano Feliciani had a clear view and blows his whistle.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
89' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) comes onto the pitch for Nadir Zortea.
88' Adam Marusic (Lazio) sends a cross into the box, but Federico Ravaglia comes off his line to gather the ball.
88' Lazio seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
87' Boulaye Dia (Lazio) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Ermano Feliciani who sees an offensive foul. Bologna are awarded the free kick.
86' Thijs Dallinga (Bologna) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
82' 0 - 2 Kenneth Taylor (Lazio) is released by Boulaye Dia, he surges into the box and smashes a great shot into the net after a one-on-one with the goalkeeper.
81' A pass into the box finds Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio) unmarked. He carefully places a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Federico Ravaglia denies him.
81' Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
80' Juan Miranda (Bologna) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
77' A yellow-coloured card is received by Kenneth Taylor (Lazio).
75' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to make a change. Thijs Dallinga (Bologna) replaces Federico Bernardeschi.
75' Substitution. Torbjorn Lysaker Heggem will be replaced by Jhon Lucumi (Bologna).
72' 0 - 1 Goal! Kenneth Taylor (Lazio) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 0:1.

72' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Bologna are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
67' Referee Ermano Feliciani has finally had enough of Vincenzo Italiano and brandishes a yellow card at him!
65' Ermano Feliciani shows a yellow card to Santiago Castro (Bologna) for a tough tackle.
64' Juan Miranda (Bologna) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
62' We are about to witness a subsitution. Boulaye Dia (Lazio) for Daniel Maldini.
62' Substitution. Riccardo Orsolini makes way for Benjamin Dominguez (Bologna).
62' The manager makes a subsitution with Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) coming on for Jonathan Rowe.
61' Maurizio Sarri decides to make a substitution. Gustav Isaksen will be replaced by Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio).
61' Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) is caught offside!

60' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the left post. Federico Ravaglia pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
59' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) produces a nice first-time shot from a promising distance. Edoardo Motta pulls off a quality save to stop the ball from hitting the net.

56' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lazio.
54' Bologna are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
51' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) has a great chance to score from the penalty. He shoots to the bottom left corner, but Edoardo Motta leaps out to thwart his attempt.
51' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
50' Ermano Feliciani blows his whistle for a foul after Edoardo Motta (Lazio) hacks down one of his opponents. Bologna are awarded a penalty! What an opportunity to score.
48' Bologna control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
46' The game is over for Pedro (Lazio). Tijjani Noslin comes on for the second half.
46' The whistle blows and Ermano Feliciani starts the second half.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

42' Santiago Castro (Bologna) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Ermano Feliciani with no other option than to blow for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Lazio.
41' Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.

39' The most active player in today's match is definitely Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna). He's trying to be on the ball as much as possible and you can literally see the enthusiasm in his play. He keeps exchanging some one touch passes and waits for the right moment to send a killer pass. What a player!
37' The current number of shots on goal is 1:1.
35' Adam Marusic (Lazio) takes a shot after receiving a good pass, but his effort from the edge of the box goes just over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Bologna will have a goal kick.

33' Nikola Moro (Bologna) skips perfectly past challenges but misdirects his shot from the edge of the box. The ball flies a few yards over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lazio.
32' Wonderful movement by Bologna. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
29' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Gustav Isaksen (Lazio).
26' Problems for Maurizio Sarri as Mario Gila is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Oliver Provstgaard (Lazio) replaces him.
24' The game is interrupted now, Mario Gila (Lazio) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
22' Crossbar! Nikola Moro (Bologna) picks up a precise pass and produces a bullet of a strike from distance that smashes against the crossbar. It could have been a brilliant goal.
18' The ball goes out of play. Bologna are awarded a corner kick.
18' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
15' Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
11' Neat passing move from Bologna in order to create new attacking opportunities.
8' Federico Bernardeschi (Bologna) touches the ball with his hand. Lazio win a free kick.
5' Lazio have a corner.
5' Lazio are passing the ball across the pitch and keep possession. However, an opponent intercepts a pass and the situation changes. Lazio force a corner. They send men into the box.
4' The Bologna players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
2' Fisayo Dele-Bashiru (Lazio) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball. It's a free kick to Bologna, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
1' The first half has just begun.
Lazio will kick-off.
Ermano Feliciani was nominated as the referee for this game.
